q2_gaps: A postural verb used non-literally for institutional membership ("sits on the Council"): *Where a THING is* says a bare position clause mints no event whatever its verb, and lists sit, which would give the entity-attached (On brindle_coombe sk_council_1) with no event and no reification trigger present; the prepositional-verb rule instead gives a reified sit event with the (On <event> <object>) oblique. Nothing in the instruction set decides which applies when the clause asserts no physical position, and neither encoding records the membership the sentence states.
notes: "The Council" correctly stays a plain common-noun witness with no Name atom (capitalized-common-noun default), and no type atom is invented for the multi-word name Brindle Coombe. Experiencer follows the stative-intransitive rule, and On is the preposition actually used.
